decision_notes: The official National Assembly archive explicitly designates Videonet, whose plenary index links the selected MP4 archives. Two samples decode in Chromium and WebKit: the 31 August 2026 voting-day recording shows the presiding officer at the branded parliamentary dais with a lit microphone; a part of the 28 August recording shows Marina Mijatović speaking at a lit seat microphone with her source caption. Chairing context is not described as a separately identified speech. These are selected archived proceedings, not a validated current-live channel or complete sitting inventory.

The reviewed primary parliamentary/provider navigation establishes public viewing, not a blanket independent audiovisual reuse grant. Personal-use permission remains pending; link to the official archive rather than rehosting, extracting a live channel or exporting these large event recordings to IPTV.
